title: Aerlib: Shaders
description: Readds the old secret setting shaders to 1.21.1's files. Originally meant for the Origins mod, but works as a general library.
body:
## About

A small, fairly lightweight mod that restores the old secret settings shaders such as Sobel, Creeper and Pencil. All shaders are still called using namespace "minecraft:" so no need to use the mod's directory, simply input as you would have in previous versions. Please note: This mod does not give you the ability to activate them on it's own, it is a library for mods and datapacks that do allow you to do that. I personally made this for use with the Origins mod, but it should work as a general library for anyone who wants these readded without needing to make a required resource pack. I will be uploading a resource pack version of this in a couple days as well, for those who don't want a modded server or client - though I don't quite know what the purpose of that would be.

Was thrown together rather quickly, so you might encounter bugs.
If you run into issues or bugs, or want a custom shader added, please let me know via discord, you can do this via my discord server: [https://discord.gg/ffNj492tXe], please do note that the server is currently a work in progress.

## Usage & Assets:

Feel free to use as a library as you wish or include in any modpacks. The shader assets that originate from minecraft are free use as well as they do not belong to me and were origially created by the developers of minecraft, I've simply ported them to a newer version. I will likely add my own custom shaders at a later date, when I do, those shaders will be added to a list at the bottom of this description and will be my assets, free to be used within this mod as provided.
